test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_wide_arrays_of_objects_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_wide_arrays_of_objects_src SELECT '{"a":' || toString(number) || ',"b' || toString(number % 1000) || '":[' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> '{"k1":"v' || toString(number % 50 + i) || '","k2":' || toString(i) || ',"k3":' || if(i % 2 = 1, 'true', 'false') || ',"k4":' || toString(number % 100 / 8) || ',"k5":"x","k6":{"k7":"y' || toString(i) || '","k8":' || toString(number % 13) || '}}', range(3)), ',') || ']}' FROM numbers(200000)
test.query: SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 16) FROM json_wide_arrays_of_objects_src FORMAT Null
